title: Tooling: reuse same-call inventory SHA with retained checks
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

The original H25 file inventory hashes each accepted file twice after reading it once. This component computes SHA-256 once, after the original pin lookup, and reuses it for the comparison and returned metadata. Every file read, traversal, pin, mode/stat and completeness check remains. The literal original functions and 11 original controls are retained. No cross-call cache, arithmetic change, native integration, whole-caller speedup or kappa claim.

## Task and overlap

Explicit donor assignment: reduce verification bookkeeping using timeboxed GPT-6.1-sol high implementation and independent review, preserving checks and incremental commits. Base a7638a4ce2a29947457ae8d6bf8cd70a234dfeac; source commit 876626e3cacf05b8a6cc3795734b08254b08c4b7; evidence commit c95f76dfad324e6488a88dab9988ce534ee2a481. Scope is the inventory-only subset of the existing digest/observation work. PR2348 concerns different instruction-JSON fragment reuse; PR6326 is the separate serializer contribution. Their files and claims are unchanged. Bounded overlap checks are not proof of novelty.

## Validation and observed result

Independent agent review accepted 27 normal and 27 optimized control cases, then the complete declared inventory comparison. Each comparison process performed 128 fresh inventories of the same 32-file, 453,700-byte corpus. All four 4,409-byte outputs matched the independent source-derived expectation. All reads and checks remain; the source bill falls from 8,192 to 4,096 inventory SHA calls per process.

| Fixed first observation | Outer wall | User CPU | System CPU | GNU max RSS |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Baseline 1 | 1.48 s | 1.28 s | 0.17 s | 21,996 KiB |
| Candidate 1 | 1.25 s | 1.07 s | 0.15 s | 21,756 KiB |
| Candidate 2 | 1.19 s | 1.02 s | 0.17 s | 22,092 KiB |
| Baseline 2 | 1.29 s | 1.12 s | 0.17 s | 22,064 KiB |

Baseline totals: 2.77 s wall / 2.74 s CPU. Candidate totals: 2.44 s wall / 2.41 s CPU, observed reductions of 11.91% / 12.04% in this fixed workload on this host. Two samples per arm at hundredths resolution do not establish significance, a repeatable magnitude or a full-verifier gain. No RSS saving is claimed. All first observations are retained; no retry, reroll or best-sample selection occurred.

The outer timed envelope includes independent expected-output validation, source/runtime/guard/log checks, fixture work, cleanup and validation-record readback. The rejected first timing proposal and its reviewed source correction are retained. Six operations measured 6.40 s wall / 6.29 s CPU; their policy debit was 18.46 s, taking the existing shared ledger to 94.210533479 / 2400 s. Nominal administration, outside preparation/review/publication and historical/final metadata timing gaps remain separate and OPEN_NOT_ZERO.

All 191 published file blobs match the local reviewed export. See [package README](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/c95f76dfad324e6488a88dab9988ce534ee2a481/research/h25-inventory-digest-reuse-20261031/README.md), PUBLIC-OUTCOME.json, raw evidence/execution-v1 and validation/controls. Original host/path/runtime pins are archival; reproduction requires freshly reviewed host bindings and resource admission. No registered hosted replay hook is supplied. Hosted planning and executable replay are reported separately in the delivery comment.

## Credit

Chris R / Clear1nsight, CrocSwap, PR6029/PR5864 and the retained Douglas R. Colkitt circuit/network/verification lineage; PR6316 supplies the preserved bounded-log guard. Original attribution and Apache-2.0 licensing remain. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance with GPT-6.1-sol high author and independent reviewer agents. No independent human or proof-kernel acceptance claimed.

## Open next questions

Independently reproduce this scoped inventory result with fresh host pins before integration or generalization. The README distinguishes the historical source-stage questions from current next work. Broader ordered-observation reuse, complete caller validation and original six-area completion remain separate. The serializer and paused cache handoffs remain on PR6326 and PR6321.
